about: The rules every PEA gateway must follow. gateway.py reads this file when it starts and the Mac app embeds it at build time, so neither keeps its own copy. Change it only together with the conformance tests.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client; style-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/style; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com https://openrouter.ai https://api.github.com https://accounts.google.com https://www.googleapis.com https://docs.googleapis.com https://forms.googleapis.com; frame-src https://accounts.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

reminders.about: POST replaces the whole list of reminders a gateway may show as system notifications; GET says whether it can show any. A gateway that cannot show notifications checks the list the same way and answers that it is not available.
